entries.title: Dynamic Pricing Signal Model
entries.desc: ML model that suggests optimal list price to sellers based on recent sales velocity and competitor pricing.
entries.findings: Model recommendations tracked 6-9% higher sell-through in backtesting vs static pricing. Cold-start problem for newly listed titles remains unsolved.

entries.title: Fraud Velocity Graph Analysis
entries.desc: Graph-based clustering of orders, payment methods, and IP ranges to catch card-testing rings before chargebacks land.
entries.findings: Catches roughly 78% of known card-testing patterns in backtest. False-positive rate on legitimate bulk gift-purchase bursts still too high (~4%) — tuning threshold.

entries.title: Search Relevance Ranking Overhaul
entries.desc: Learning-to-rank model for catalog search, evaluated against the current keyword-plus-popularity heuristic.
entries.findings: Offline ranking quality improved 11% over baseline. Needs a live A/B test before rollout; watching for interaction effects with sponsored listings.

entries.title: Key Redemption Checksum Verification
entries.desc: Cryptographic checksum scheme sellers can attach to key listings so buyers can verify authenticity before redeeming on the publisher platform.
entries.findings: Works cleanly for 4 of 6 major publisher platforms tested. Two platforms rotate key formats without notice, breaking checksum matching — investigating a fallback.

entries.title: Seller Payout Automation via Instant Rails
entries.desc: Evaluating instant bank payout rails as an alternative to the current weekly batch payout for sellers.
entries.findings: Initial research phase. Comparing provider fee structures and settlement times.

entries.title: Chat Support Triage Bot
entries.desc: Lightweight intent-classification bot to route buyer support tickets (missing key, refund, seller dispute) before human handoff.
entries.findings: Correctly routes 81% of tickets across the three most common categories. Struggles with mixed-intent messages such as 'key didn't work and I want a refund'.

entries.title: Currency Conversion Drift Monitoring
entries.desc: Tracking FX rate staleness on displayed regional prices to catch stale-quote complaints before they escalate.
entries.findings: Median quote staleness under 40 minutes across regions. AP-Southeast lags most due to slower upstream FX feed refresh.

entries.title: Duplicate Listing Detection
entries.desc: Fuzzy-matching seller listings against a title and edition catalog to catch accidental or deliberate duplicate listings.
entries.findings: Catches straightforward duplicates reliably. Regional edition variants (same base game, different key region) still trip false positives.

entries.title: Wishlist-to-Purchase Conversion Study
entries.desc: Analyzing which nudges (price-drop alert, bundle suggestion, urgency messaging) actually convert wishlisted items into purchases.
entries.findings: Initial research phase. Reviewing conversion-nudge studies from comparable marketplaces.

entries.title: Bundle Recommendation Engine
entries.desc: Collaborative-filtering model suggesting complementary key bundles at checkout based on co-purchase patterns.
entries.findings: Initial research phase. Scoping training data requirements.
